answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jade of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
